rules: single index.html, every resource inlined (base64), no external network calls
MRAID 2.0: wait for 'ready' (or getState() != 'loading') before any MRAID call
timer and audio start only after the first user interaction
no auto-redirect to the store; works in portrait and landscape
single minified index.html, inlined, no links to other files
MRAID 3.0: start content only after viewableChange(true)
no XHR; no auto-redirect; never cover the close button
call gameReady() once loaded, gameEnd() when the end card shows, install() on CTA
the host starts the ad through window.gameStart()
single HTML or zip (mintegral.zip > mintegral/mintegral.html); callback names unconfirmed from Mintegral's own doc: check in the Mintegral playable test tool
no localStorage, no external fonts except Google Fonts, UTF-8 text
audio only after the first interaction
google.test: Google Ads HTML5 Validator (For App Campaigns)
